title: Voice vocabulary and quick chips, redesigned to line up with tags

steps.path: Chat → Edit quick chips → the pencil on a chip
steps.headline: Which chip editor matches the tag editor better?
steps.notice: Each picture shows the chip editor beside a tag's edit box (Session details → click a tag), the closest similar popup.

variants.label: Keep today's
variants.summary: Today (commit 7b41b47fe): a name over each box (Name, Message) and the switch and buttons inside the same box, exactly like the tag edit box. Most consistent; I recommend this one.

variants.label: Go back
variants.summary: Before: boxes with no names, the switch in a second box, buttons under the boxes.
variants.risk: Differs from the tag edit box in all three ways.

steps.path: Chat → right-click the microphone → Voice vocabulary
steps.headline: Voice vocabulary, redesigned to line up with Tags.
steps.notice: Kept unique: no colours (a word is not a tag), no suggestions list, and the note that words are hints for Parakeet.

variants.label: Today
variants.summary: An unlabelled explanation box, "Your words", a box with an Add button beside it, a status line, and a Save button outside the box.

variants.label: Proposed
variants.summary: One "Your words" box like the Tags box: tag-sized chips, "Add a word" over one box, the explanation as grey words under it. Each change saves at once like tags, so no Save button or status line. I recommend this one.
variants.risk: No way to back out of several edits at once; a removed word is gone (add it again).

steps.path: Typing a new word ("Parakeet" typed in each)
steps.headline: How should the Add button work? Pictures with a word typed in.

variants.label: Inside the box
variants.summary: An Add button appears inside the box once you type, exactly like the tag box's Create. Enter also adds. Most like Tags; I recommend this one.

variants.label: Enter only
variants.summary: No button: the box says "then press Enter".
variants.risk: Someone who doesn't press Enter has nothing to click.

variants.label: Beside the box
variants.summary: Today's way: an outlined Add button next to the box.

steps.headline: Quick chips, lined up with Tags. Which look?
steps.notice: Kept unique: the two shelves, dragging, the pencil on a chip, and the dashed "+ Add a chip" (like Tags' "+ New tag").

variants.label: Today
variants.summary: The how-to line is small (11px) and inside the box.

variants.label: Words under the box
variants.summary: The how-to line moves under the box as 12px grey words, your rule. Chips keep the look of the real chips above the message box, so the editor previews what you'll see. I recommend this one.

variants.label: Also tag-shaped chips
variants.summary: Same, plus chips shaped like tag chips (round, a little taller).
variants.risk: The chips no longer look like the ones above your message box.
